items.title: Former UNESCO chief: Shenzhen epitomizes China's dynamic growth
items.description: Irina Bokova, former director-general of UNESCO, said in a recent interview with China Daily that Shenzhen has risen as an early beneficiary of China's reform and opening-up. In her view, Shenzhen is now full of vitality, with rich and diverse connotations.

items.title: Protests reveal Europe's economic dilemma
items.description: Protests across Europe are exposing deeper economic challenges, from sluggish growth and declining industrial competitiveness to rising energy costs and mounting fiscal pressures. As geopolitical tensions add to the strain, governments face growing difficulties in addressing public grievances. Is Europe heading for a prolonged economic and social crisis?
